## Skills

**Programming and computing** — R, Python, Java, Bash, Unix; HPC cluster
systems (SLURM, PBS, LSF); Git; SQL and PostgreSQL

**Genomics** — genome assembly (IRMA, SPAdes, nf-core/viralrecon),
metagenomics (nf-core/mag), taxonomic classification (Kraken2), GWAS,
transcriptomics

**Phylogenetics** — maximum likelihood reconstruction (RAxML, IQ-TREE),
Bayesian reconstruction (BEAST 1 and 2)

**Wet lab** — PCR, RT-qPCR, DNA extraction (FTA blood card, arthropods),
Sanger sequencing

**Languages** — English, Tamil, Telugu (native); Spanish, French (limited)

## Service

Ad hoc reviewer for *Proceedings of the Royal Society B*, *PLOS Pathogens*,

Disease*, *npj Viruses*, *Scientific Reports*, *Infectious Diseases of
Poverty*, *One Health Outlook*, and *Tropical Medicine and Health*.
